# JDS Sommer GmbH

> JDS Sommer GmbH in Frankfurt am Main, Germany (founded 1984), turns existing drawings, scans and point clouds into usable CAD and BIM data: 2D CAD digitalisation and vectorisation, 3D CAD modelling, Scan to BIM and reverse engineering. Around 2,000 customers across industries; more than 1,000 drawings converted per month. Quotes and advice are free of charge.

The website is in English (site root) and German (/de/). Prices are net, plus VAT.

## Services

Five service areas: 2D digitalisation, 3D modelling, as-built documentation and facility management, GIS and infrastructure data digitalisation, and Scan-to-CAD modelling.

- [2D CAD Digitalisation](https://www.jds-sommer.de/2d-cad-digitizing): paper plans, PDFs and scanned technical drawings (A4 up to multiples of A0) turned into structured, editable CAD files with agreed layers, dimensions, text and output formats. Prices from €49 per A0 drawing (DWG-Basic), €75 (DWG-Premium), from €99 (DWG-Premium Plus); delivery in 5 days (standard), 3 days (urgent) or 24 hours (express).
  - [Drawing-to-CAD conversion](https://www.jds-sommer.de/2d-cad-digitizing#drawing-to-cad-conversion): paper drawings, PDFs and raster images to editable 2D CAD in AutoCAD DWG, DXF, MicroStation DGN or, where agreed, Allplan.
  - [Scan-to-CAD](https://www.jds-sommer.de/2d-cad-digitizing#scan-to-cad): registered point clouds and laser scans to 2D floor plans, sections and elevations of existing buildings (DWG, DXF, DGN).
  - [CAD restructuring and standardisation](https://www.jds-sommer.de/2d-cad-digitizing#cad-restructuring): existing DWG, DXF or DGN files aligned with the client's CAD guidelines, layer standards, line styles, fonts and dimensions.
- [3D CAD and BIM Modelling](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling): 3D CAD and BIM models from point clouds, laser scans, STL data and existing plans, at LOD 100 to 500. Objects up to 150 cm are scanned in-house. 3D scanning from €65 per point cloud; 3D CAD modelling of a machine part from €250.
  - [Scan-to-BIM](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling#scan-to-bim): registered point clouds and terrestrial laser scans to 3D BIM models (Revit RVT, IFC, Allplan, Archicad).
  - [CAD-to-BIM modelling](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling#cad-to-bim): existing 2D CAD drawings and building plans to structured 3D BIM models.
  - [As-built BIM modelling](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling#as-built-bim): BIM models of a building or facility as it exists today, from survey data, point clouds and existing documentation.
  - [3D CAD modelling and reverse engineering](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling#3d-cad-modelling): components and technical objects from scan data, STL meshes or engineering drawings to 3D CAD (STEP, IGES).
  - [Industrial facility and technical installation modelling](https://www.jds-sommer.de/3d-bim-modeling#industrial-facility-modelling): 3D CAD/BIM models of industrial facilities, equipment and piping from scans and drawings.
- As-built documentation and facility management: as-built drawings and facility documentation created and updated from agreed site information and existing building records. Quoted on request.
- GIS and infrastructure data digitalisation: infrastructure plans and spatial information turned into structured data for mapping, asset records and GIS workflows. Quoted on request.
